Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: high-quality transparent front-view controller illustration embedded in an actual Windows emulator controls page. Create ONLY one isolated controller, large and sharply detailed, straight orthographic front/top view as seen looking down at the face of a controller resting flat. All controls visible. Realistic polished product-render quality with subtle matte material and precise engineering, no cartoon outline, no neon contour, no stand, no environment, no text labels outside the controller, no cables, no extra accessories. Keep the complete controller inside the image, even narrow transparent padding, true alpha transparent background and no ground plane/shadow outside the object. Landscape 3:2 composition, controller occupies most of width. Sharp edges at high DPI. Buttons must be anatomically located correctly. Subject: a recognizable matte graphite Xbox Series controller, accurate sculpted ergonomic shell and handles, asymmetrical analog sticks: left stick upper-left, faceted circular directional pad lower-left, right stick lower-middle-right. The face-button diamond is correctly labeled Y at top (yellow), B at right (red), A at bottom (green), X at left (blue). Correct Menu and View small buttons near center, small share button, round central home button. Shoulder buttons LB and RB along top, triggers behind. Tasteful premium realistic shading, believable molded plastics and textured sticks. No Sony design, no symmetrical sticks, no exaggerated perspective. Plain central home emblem rather than a corporate wordmark.
